# Avali
[color=#ffa500]Warning! This species is not recommended for new players due to major gameplay changes![/color]
Avali are a species of ammonia-based intelligent bird/raptor people and due to this odd combination many refer to them as "Space Raptors" and, as you might expect, are carnivores. Their unique biology allows them to deal exceedingly well with the cold, and is capable of basic flight in no to low gravity environments.
## Racial Features
- Receive [color=#ffa500]40% more fire damage[/color] and [color=#1e90ff]40% less cold damage[/color]. - Can stand in tempatures of up to [color=#1e90ff]-50c before taking cold damage[/color]. - Deal [color=red]6.25[/color] slashing damage with claws. - Can fly in Zero-G, but require equipment to move while floating in space.
- Can talk over [color=#ffbc48]The Nexus with +N.[/color] - 2x Hunger rate, stay fed! - Can only eat meat-related food items (including organs) and pills. - Heal airloss from Ammonia and Amoxla but.. - Saline will burn you, and both Dexalin and Dexalin+ are lethal to you. Remember to remind doctors about it! - Fall into crit at 90 and dead at 180.
## Avali Naming Conventions
Avali typically have a naming scheme of a first name from their language followed by their packname with the word "of" in between. Avali who don't have a pack typically will just go by their first name. - [color=#449944]Acceptable:[/color] Ko of Ironclaw Pack - [color=#449944]Acceptable:[/color] Jasyo of Sprinter Pack - [color=#449944]Acceptable:[/color] Ralomi - [color=#994444]Bad:[/color] Slasher Pack - [color=#994444]Bad:[/color] Velociraptor
## Lore
As the Avali's designation of "Space Raptors" implies, there is a remarkable amount of evidence shows evolutionary links between them and dinosaurs. These similarities actually led to the discovery that some species of dinosaurs, such as the velociraptor, were actually not from Earth but rather sent from another world. Though may theories exist on the reasoning of this phenomena, the only theory with credible backing is that the Resomi, a sentient species now believed to be extinct, long ago created the dinosaurs and sent them to many worlds as a part of an unknown experiment.
